purpose: Citation-audit passage access policy. Sources absent here remain receipt-level-only and must be named unverifiable-by-design in citation-audit reports.
usage_note: OpenStax book pages currently identify CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and additional OpenStax terms restricting ingestion into large language models or generative AI offerings without written permission. This policy records text-access provenance only; it does not decide whether any particular adjudicator/model or downstream dataset use is permitted. That rights decision must be explicit before production reliance.
